open_points.subject: create-project replay eligibility
open_points.text: while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: Which stored values must remain unchanged for a retried create to retain its no-second-project guarantee, and which later actions count as changing them?
options: Only values supplied by create must remain equal
Every value on the project record, including status and revision, must remain unchanged
The whole project card, including later rooms or other related state, must remain unchanged
open_points.default_guess: Treat only the create-time input values as relevant; unrelated later state does not end replay recognition.

events: The owner creates project P with request id R, name N and object O; Registry returns P at revision 1.
The owner adds a room to P or archives P.
After losing the original answer, the owner retries the original create with request id R and the same create input.
outcomes: Registry considers P to have kept the relevant values and returns P without creating another project.
Registry considers the later room or status/revision change to mean P no longer keeps its values, so the replay guarantee no longer applies.
witness.observer: The owner and any consumer listing projects

open_points.subject: create-project retry after the first project changes
open_points.text: a retried create never makes a second project while the first keeps its values
open_points.question: What observable output or failure occurs when the original project still exists but no longer keeps those values because it was corrected, archived, or otherwise changed?
options: Return the existing project in its current state
Refuse the retry because the original result no longer matches
Treat it as a new create and mint a second project
open_points.default_guess: Refuse the retry and leave the existing project unchanged.

events: The owner creates project P with request id R and receives P.
The owner corrects P, changing its display name or object and advancing its revision.
The owner retries the original create request R with its original values.
outcomes: Registry returns the now-corrected P and creates nothing.
Registry refuses the request, or treats it as a new create and mints another project, because the stated no-duplicate promise no longer applies.
witness.observer: The owner and consumers of the project catalogue
